Coder A accepted the Chamber of Deputies CEDES (Resolucao 26/2013) under the legislature technology-assessment clause and rejected Ipea as a think tank; coder B did the reverse. Adjudicated with B: CEDES art. 2 II (read by the adjudicator) mandates feasibility and impact studies of technologies, plans and policies, with no long-term or emerging-change wording, so condition 3 fails; Ipea is a federal public foundation (condition 1) whose statute, Decreto 11.194 of 8 Sep 2022, art. 3 III, names medium and long-term prospective studies (condition 3), and it operated after the 1 Jan 2023 change (condition met for I3). The MPO long-term planning undersecretariat (Decreto 11.353, art. 16) carries I1 and I2. SAE closed 1 Jan 2023 with the prospective mandate moved to MPO the same day, so I4 is 0. Score 100.

adjudications.reason: gov.br/planejamento Brasil 2050 page: 'a Secretaria Nacional de Planejamento está liderando a construção' of the Estratégia Brasil 2050. Decree 11.365 of 1 Jan 2023, issued on the day the presidency changed, revoked it. It ended at a change, which I3 codes did_not_survive. adjudications.split: Low confidence (A): A rejects; B did not list it

'O futuro do País' (the future of the country) is not one of the listed terms or a direct equivalent of 'futures studies'. The codebook does not say whether a bare 'future' counts as a direct equivalent of 'futures'. Read strictly, it does not.

adjudications.split: A rejects (no founding act or mandate found); B meets unit
adjudications.reason: The Federal Council's 2010 business report (BK) records the constitutive meeting of the newly formed Perspektivstab on 12 Nov 2009 under the goal 'Früherkennung wichtiger Entwicklungen und Trends', with four alternative future scenarios. The BK page credits it with the 2007, 2011 and 2014 futures reports. B's Federal Council decision of 18 Sep 2009 was not found in the 2009 report. It is an interdepartmental staff, and section 1 does not say outright that such a staff is an organisational unit. It was operating after the 2010 council-majority change, so survived is 1. Its end is undated, and the BK carries the mandate in the same branch.

adjudications.split: Low confidence (A): whether 'Lage- und Umfeldanalyse' names a foresight function
adjudications.reason: bk.admin.ch: the analysis aims to identify and anticipate developments of the coming 10 to 15 years, using future scenarios. The 2026 report calls this work strategische Vorausschau. Read as a direct equivalent of horizon scanning. Section 1 condition 3 leaves 'direct equivalents' to the coder.

adjudications.split: Low confidence (B)
adjudications.reason: No dated end record for the Perspektivstab exists. The BK has held the same mandate in the executive branch since 2015, so the closure has a successor.

Only the repeal of the Fund Act (s. 22) waits until 1 Jul 2017. The foresight closure is outside the I4 window, so the branch rule does not apply.
